Official SNAP, WIC or other food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences

coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: All 12 targeted searches and 6 direct-source checks succeeded. No verified, newly reported qualifying food-access disruption identified since prior heartbeat. Search freshness/indexing cannot establish exhaustive nationwide absence.

coverage_notes.controls: No editorial approval, publication, production collector change, schedule modification or task disabling.
